farms._emissionSplit: The two farm pools are added to ShareRewardPool with alloc points 75 and 20. Worked example: of every 100 xSHARE the farms emit, 75 go to the xTOMB LP pool, 20 to the xSHARE LP pool, and 5 to the weekly loyalty boost (the weeklyBoostPercent below). The split stays exact because the boost is weighted against the pools' combined alloc points.
farms._weekLengthDays: Length of one loyalty week, in days. 7 = a calendar week. Set with setWeekLength BEFORE the farm start time — it locks the moment the farm starts, so week boundaries never move under stakers. Valid range 1-30 days. The 7-day progress bar in the app reads this same week.
farms._weeklyBoostPercent: Percent of farm xSHARE emissions routed to the weekly loyalty boost, paid to stakers who held LP for the whole prior week with zero LP withdrawals. 5 = five percent. Set with setBoostPercent after deployment. Valid range 0-25; 0 turns the boost off. Changing it live is safe: accrual settles under the old percent first.

note: Weekly loyalty boost — specs.md §8 (farms) and §18 (weekly loyalty reward). Applied by the farm operator on ShareRewardPool after deployment. Every value here is a whole human unit — percents and days, never bps or wei. Contract code converts.
